absent: Locking and concurrency rules for probe, hub and systab access.
Full user unwinder state machine and error handling beyond width and frame initializers.
Semantics of BIOS watchlist, frequency, partition and VGA operations plus heap management.
Exact bit meanings of floating, segment and debug state beyond field sizes.
Initialization order and lifetime of UV hub tables and per-CPU pointers.
Behavior of cross-dossier helpers such as mode tests and EFI validity marker.

findings.text: User unwinder exposes helpers for slot width reporting and function entry detection. Width helper consumes register state and yields an integer size. Entry helper consumes register state and yields a boolean via uprobe entry logic.
Unwind slot width is zero when virtual 8086 mode flag is set, meaning VM86 stacks are not unwindable. Otherwise width is eight when user 64-bit mode holds and four otherwise.

Normal frame-pointer initializer sets field cfa_off to twice the width and field ra_off to negated width and field fp_off to twice negated width with use enabled. Entry initializer sets field cfa_off to single width and field ra_off to negated width and field fp_off to zero with use disabled.
Entry detection forwards register state to uprobe entry predicate. The header-local predicate in this lane always reports false, so true outcomes depend on the cross-dossier implementation.

Instruction limit named MAX_UINSN_BYTES equals 16 while out-of-line slot named UPROBE_XOL_SLOT_BYTES equals 128 with cache alignment. Breakpoint opcode named UPROBE_SWBP_INSN equals 204 with size named UPROBE_SWBP_INSN_SIZE equal to 1. Optimize flags use 0 for can-optimize and 1 for optimize-fail, and opcode storage is one unsigned byte.

Probe descriptor holds overlapping opcode buffers named insn and ixol each sized by the instruction limit, plus operation pointer named ops and flag word named flags. One option carries branch displacement named offs with length named ilen and opcode named opc1. A second option carries fixups with length for default parameters. A third option carries register offset named reg_offset with length for push handling.

Per-task probe record keeps saved trap number named saved_trap_nr and saved trap flag named saved_tf. On 64-bit builds it additionally preserves one scratch register named saved_scratch_register across execution.

User extended state groups YMM high storage as 64 words named ymmh_space, plus header with feature mask named xfeatures and two reserved words and five further reserved words, plus legacy floating area with 58 words named fpx_space and 6 software words named xstate_fx_sw under group i387, followed by header and YMM high group with room for future extensions.
Count named USER_XSTATE_FX_SW_WORDS equals 6 and index named USER_XSTATE_XCR0_WORD equals 0.

Compat 32-bit floating state provides x87 view with control plus status plus tag and instruction plus data pointers and 20 words register space, and FXSR view with control plus status plus tag plus opcode and pointers and MXCSR with reserved and 32 words floating plus 32 words XMM plus 56 padding. Register view holds ebx with ecx with edx plus esi with edi with ebp with eax, segments ds with es with fs with gs each with padding slot named __ds and __es and __fs and __gs, plus orig_eax with eip plus cs with eflags plus esp with ss including padding __cs and __ss. Container aggregates registers with fpvalid flag and x87 state plus text plus data plus stack sizes with code plus stack starts plus signal with reserved plus ar0 with fpstate pointer plus magic with 32 byte command and eight debug registers.

Native 32-bit x87 view uses long words for control plus status plus tag with pointers and 20 words space. FXSR view uses short control plus status plus tag plus opcode with long pointers and MXCSR with reserved and 32 words floating plus 32 words XMM plus 56 padding. Register view holds bx with cx with dx plus si with di with bp with ax, segments ds with es with fs with gs, plus orig_ax with ip with cs with flags plus sp with ss. Container aggregates registers with fpvalid flag and x87 state plus text plus data plus stack sizes with code plus stack starts plus signal with reserved plus ar0 with floating pointer plus magic with 32 byte command and eight debug registers.

64-bit floating view holds short control plus status plus tag plus opcode, 64-bit instruction plus data pointers, MXCSR with mask, 32 words floating plus 64 words XMM plus 24 padding. Register view holds r15 with r14 with r13 plus r12 with bp with bx plus r11 with r10 with r9 plus r8 with ax with cx plus dx with si with di plus orig_ax with ip with cs plus flags with sp with ss plus fs_base with gs_base plus ds with es with fs with gs. Container aggregates registers with fpvalid plus pad0 plus floating state, plus text plus data plus stack sizes with code plus stack starts, plus signal with reserved plus pad1, plus ar0 with floating pointer plus magic with 32 byte command plus eight debug registers plus error code plus fault address.

Firmware command set includes operation named UV_BIOS_COMMON and serial query named UV_BIOS_GET_SN_INFO and frequency query named UV_BIOS_FREQ_BASE, plus watchlist alloc named UV_BIOS_WATCHLIST_ALLOC and watchlist free named UV_BIOS_WATCHLIST_FREE and protection named UV_BIOS_MEMPROTECT, plus partition lookup named UV_BIOS_GET_PARTITION_ADDR and VGA target named UV_BIOS_SET_LEGACY_VGA_TARGET.

Extra base named UV_BIOS_EXTRA equals 65536 with topology named UV_BIOS_GET_PCI_TOPOLOGY equal to 65537 and geoinfo named UV_BIOS_GET_GEOINFO equal to 65539. Flag named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_OP_MEM_COPYIN equals 4096 and flag named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_OP_MEM_COPYOUT equals 8192 with mask named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_OP_MASK equal to 4095. Size named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_GET_HEAPSIZE equals 1 and install named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_INSTALL_HEAP equals 2 and master named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_MASTER_NASID equals 3. Count named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_OBJECT_COUNT uses base 10 combined with copy-out and objects named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_ENUM_OBJECTS uses base 12 combined with copy-out and ports named UV_BIOS_EXTRA_ENUM_PORTS uses base 13 combined with copy-out.

Status named BIOS_STATUS_MORE_PASSES equals 1 and status named BIOS_STATUS_SUCCESS equals 0, plus status named BIOS_STATUS_UNIMPLEMENTED as negated not-implemented and status named BIOS_STATUS_EINVAL as negated invalid and status named BIOS_STATUS_UNAVAIL as negated busy and status named BIOS_STATUS_ABORT as negated interrupted.

GAM conversion block carries MMR base named mmr_base with GRU base named gru_base plus shifts named mmr_shift and gru_shift and gpa_shift with one unused byte. Range entry carries type byte with unused byte plus NASID named nasid and socket named sockid and pnode named pnode with unused word and limit named limit covering high physical bits. Architecture entry holds eight byte name field named archtype.

Shift named UV_GAM_RANGE_SHFT equals 26 for 64 MB granularity. Type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_UNUSED equals 0 as end marker and type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_RAM equals 1 and type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_NVRAM equals 2, plus type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_NV_WINDOW equals 3 and type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_NV_MAILBOX equals 4 and type named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_HOLE equals 5, with maximum named UV_GAM_RANGE_TYPE_MAX equal to 6.

Signature named UV_SYSTAB_SIG uses four characters UVST. Version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_1 equals 1 for early UV, plus version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV4 equals 1024 with version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV4_1 equal to 1025 adding GPA shift and version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV4_2 equal to 1026 adding NVRAM kinds and version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV4_3 equal to 1027 dropping PXM while latest named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV4_LATEST aliases 1027, plus version named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV5 equals 1280 with latest named UV_SYSTAB_VERSION_UV5_LATEST aliasing 1280. Types use 0 for unused named UV_SYSTAB_TYPE_UNUSED as end and 1 for GAM params named UV_SYSTAB_TYPE_GAM_PARAMS and 2 for range table named UV_SYSTAB_TYPE_GAM_RNG_TBL and 3 for arch type named UV_SYSTAB_TYPE_ARCH_TYPE with maximum named UV_SYSTAB_TYPE_MAX equal to 4. Name size named UV_AT_SIZE equals 8 for seven characters plus terminator.

System table starts with four byte signature named signature and 32-bit revision named revision, plus firmware callback pointer named function and 32-bit size named size, followed by variable entries named entry each packing eight bit type named type and twenty four bit byte offset named offset from table start. Architecture entry holds eight byte name field.

Firmware callback accepts a BIOS command as first argument with variable trailing arguments and returns a 64-bit status or value using EFI calling convention. Callers pass commands from the common set or extra space and interpret status codes including more-passes continuation.

Hub description carries numeric identifier named id and flag group distinguishing current partition named this_part and shared named is_shared and disabled named is_disabled with 128 byte name named name and location named location plus port count named ports. Port description carries port number named port with connection identifier named conn_id and connection port named conn_port.
Selector named BIOS_FREQ_BASE_PLATFORM equals 0 and selector named BIOS_FREQ_BASE_INTERVAL_TIMER equals 1 and selector named BIOS_FREQ_BASE_REALTIME_CLOCK equals 2.

Partition info overlays a 64-bit value named val with bit fields for hub version named hub_version in eight bits and partition identifier named partition_id in sixteen bits and coherence identifier named coherence_id in sixteen bits and region size named region_size in twenty four bits.
States named UV_MEMPROT_RESTRICT_ACCESS then UV_MEMPROT_ALLOW_AMO then UV_MEMPROT_ALLOW_RW represent increasing permission from restricted to atomics to full read and write.
Kind named UV_NONE and kind named UV_LEGACY_APIC and kind named UV_X2APIC cover none plus legacy plus extended APIC presence. Process node name uses six characters sgi_uv.

Helper named uv translating type to mask yields single bit for values zero through thirty inclusive and yields one otherwise, so zero means any. Early test named is_early_uv_system is true when systab physical address is set and differs from invalid marker. Fallback named get_uv_system_type reports none with checks named is_uv_system and is_uv_hubbed reporting zero and inits named uv_cpu_init and uv_system_init doing nothing.

Struct named geo_common_s holds type with blade with slot with position named upos and rack. Structs named geo_node_s plus geo_rtr_s plus geo_iocntl_s reuse common part unchanged, struct named geo_pcicard_s adds bus and slot, struct named geo_cpu_s adds socket plus thread nibbles with core, struct named geo_mem_s adds memory bus with slot. Union named geoid_u overlays all views with eight byte padding.

Size named GEOID_SIZE equals 8 and length named GEO_MAX_LEN equals 48. Code named GEO_TYPE_INVALID equals 0 and code named GEO_TYPE_MODULE equals 1 and code named GEO_TYPE_NODE equals 2, plus code named GEO_TYPE_RTR equals 3 and code named GEO_TYPE_IOCNTL equals 4 and code named GEO_TYPE_IOCARD equals 5 and code named GEO_TYPE_CPU equals 6 and code named GEO_TYPE_MEM equals 7, with maximum named GEO_TYPE_MAX equal to 8.

Helper named geo_rack returns negative one for invalid type and otherwise returns rack byte. Helper named geo_slot returns negative one for invalid and otherwise returns position byte. Helper named geo_blade returns negative one for invalid and otherwise computes twice blade plus slot.

Limit named UV_MAX_NUMALINK_BLADES equals 16384 and limit named UV_MAX_SSI_BLADES equals 256, with maximum named UV_MAX_NASID_VALUE twice the link count. Revision base named UV2_HUB_REVISION_BASE equals 3 and base named UV3_HUB_REVISION_BASE equals 5 and base named UV4_HUB_REVISION_BASE equals 7, plus base named UV4A_HUB_REVISION_BASE equals 8 for fixed UV4 and base named UV5_HUB_REVISION_BASE equals 9.

Kernel GAM range holds limit named limit with NASID named nasid plus base index named base and reserved byte. Per-CPU hub record holds hub pointer named p_uv_hub_info with blade CPU identifier named blade_cpu_id and reserved pointer.

Hub info aggregates type named hub_type and revision with global MMR plus GRU bases and shifts, address masks, tables named socket_to_node with socket_to_pnode with pnode_to_socket with node_to_socket, range table named gr_table with length, shift plus sizing parameters for APIC plus addressing plus coherence, remap bounds, pnode identity named pnode with mask, domain plus blade identifiers, CPU counts, memory node named memory_nid.

Accessors named uv_cpu_info with uv_cpu_info_per expose current plus indexed per-CPU pointers, lookup named uv_hub_info_list indexes by node, derivation named _uv_hub_info with uv_hub_info with uv_cpu_hub_info yields hub info, getter named uv_hub_type with setter named uv_hub_type_set manages type, testers named is_uv with is_uv1_hub with is_uv2_hub with is_uv3_hub with is_uv4a_hub with is_uv4_hub with is_uv5_hub with is_uvx_hub with is_uvy_hub check generations.

Generation test named is_uv applies bit mask against current hub type, except first generation named is_uv1_hub which unconditionally reports false. Extended testers named is_uvx_hub with is_uvy_hub check dedicated bits.

Callers must handle zero width for VM86 as non-unwindable rather than allocating zero. Firmware table parsing must validate signature plus revision plus entry offsets against size to avoid overrun. Per-CPU hub dereferences assume initialized hub pointer. Extra operation codes multiplex direction in low bits and require masking before dispatch.
Cross-dossier uprobe entry predicate owned by another dossier.
